title: Nipigon District Memorial Hospital — claimed by storm
description: CA · Healthcare · Nipigon District Memorial Hospital offers a range of healthcare services including diagnostic imaging, lab services, physiotherapy, and an assisted living program. The hospital aims to serve patients and residents in the Nipigon district, focusing on community health and well-being.
